label: Ink Callout
description: The explainer's hand-drawn annotation over a product screen: a marker note writes on ("this is where it happens"), an arrow swoops from it to the thing, and the thing gets circled, boxed or underlined -- each callout on its word, the ink gently boiling like it was drawn. A transparent full-frame overlay ABOVE the screen it points at: targets are % of the frame.

callouts.label: Callouts: { at (seconds or "@word"), label (short note), target: { x, y (CENTRE, % of frame), w, h (% of frame) }, mark ("circle" | "box" | "underline" | "arrow" = arrow only), label_at: { x, y } (optional; default placed off the target toward open space), until (optional: when this one fades) }

keep.label: Keep every callout up (default: each one clears as the next begins)

boil.label: Hand-drawn shimmer on the ink (default on)

exit_at.label: When all the ink fades (seconds or "@word"; default near the end)
